mapper.sql: dc.achievement_id AS "achievementId", dc.management_no AS "managementNo", dc.teacher_user_id AS "teacherUserId", personnel.name AS "teacherName", dc.evaluation_year AS "evaluationYear", dc.organization_code AS "organizationCode", dc.management_item_code AS "managementItemCode", dc.occurred_date AS "occurredDate", dc.achievement_detail::text AS "achievementDetail", dc.certification_status AS "certificationStatus", CASE WHEN dc.attachment_ref IS NULL THEN FALSE ELSE TRUE END AS "attachmentPresent", dc.created_at AS "createdAt", dc.updated_at AS "updatedAt"
mapper.select:
SELECT FROM degree_completion_achievements dc LEFT JOIN users teacher ON teacher.user_id = dc.teacher_user_id LEFT JOIN korus_personnel_snapshots personnel ON personnel.employee_no = teacher.employee_no
ORDER BY dc.occurred_date DESC, dc.achievement_id DESC LIMIT #{criteria.safeSize} OFFSET #{criteria.offset}

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM degree_completion_achievements dc LEFT JOIN users teacher ON teacher.user_id = dc.teacher_user_id LEFT JOIN korus_personnel_snapshots personnel ON personnel.employee_no = teacher.employee_no

SELECT FROM degree_completion_achievements dc LEFT JOIN users teacher ON teacher.user_id = dc.teacher_user_id LEFT JOIN korus_personnel_snapshots personnel ON personnel.employee_no = teacher.employee_no WHERE dc.achievement_id = #{achievementId} AND dc.deleted_yn = 'N'

SELECT FROM degree_completion_achievements dc LEFT JOIN users teacher ON teacher.user_id = dc.teacher_user_id LEFT JOIN korus_personnel_snapshots personnel ON personnel.employee_no = teacher.employee_no WHERE dc.management_no = #{managementNo} AND dc.deleted_yn = 'N'

SELECT dcs.degree_completion_student_id AS "degreeCompletionStudentId", dcs.degree_type AS "degreeType", dcs.student_name AS "studentName", dcs.thesis_title AS "thesisTitle", dcs.degree_awarded_date AS "degreeAwardedDate" FROM degree_completion_students dcs WHERE dcs.achievement_id = #{achievementId} ORDER BY dcs.degree_awarded_date DESC, dcs.degree_completion_student_id DESC

SELECT organization_code FROM organization_user_mappings WHERE user_id = #{targetUserId} AND mapping_type = 'ORGANIZATION' AND status = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY effective_start_date DESC, mapping_id DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO degree_completion_achievements ( management_no, teacher_user_id, evaluation_year, organization_code, management_item_code, occurred_date, achievement_detail, attachment_ref, created_by, updated_by, change_reason ) VALUES ( #{managementNo}, #{teacherUserId}, #{evaluationYear}, #{organizationCode}, #{managementItemCode}, #{occurredDate}, CAST(#{achievementDetail} AS jsonb), #{attachmentRef}, #{createdBy}, #{createdBy}, #{changeReason} )
mapper.update: UPDATE degree_completion_achievements SET management_item_code = #{managementItemCode}, occurred_date = #{occurredDate}, achievement_detail = CAST(#{achievementDetail} AS jsonb), attachment_ref = #{attachmentRef}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_by = #{updatedBy}, change_reason = #{changeReason} WHERE achievement_id = #{achievementId} AND deleted_yn = 'N' AND certification_status <> 'EVALUATION_CONFIRMED'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO degree_completion_students ( achievement_id, degree_type, student_name, thesis_title, degree_awarded_date, created_by, updated_by ) VALUES ( #{achievementId}, #{student.degreeType}, #{student.studentName}, #{student.thesisTitle}, #{student.degreeAwardedDate}, #{userId}, #{userId} )

INSERT INTO data_change_histories ( target_business, target_key, change_type, field_name, before_value, after_value, changed_by, change_reason ) VALUES ( 'degree_completion_achievements', CAST(#{achievementId} AS varchar), #{changeType}, #{fieldName}, #{beforeValue}, #{afterValue}, #{changedBy}, #{changeReason} )
